content: पद् I. €10 <ab>Ā.</ab> (पदयते) To go or move. --II. €4 <ab>Ā.</ab> (पद्यते, पन्न; {%<ab>caus.</ab>%} पादयति-ते; {%<ab>desid.</ab>%} पित्सते) .²1 To go, move. .²2 To go to, approach (with <ab>acc.</ab>) .²3 To attain, obtain, gain; ज्योतिषामाधिपत्यं च प्रभावं चाप्यपद्यत <ls>Mb.</ls> .²4 To observe, practise; स्वधर्मं पद्यमानास्ते <ls>Mb.</ls> .²5 <ab>Ved.</ab> To fall down with fatigue. .²6 <ab>Ved.</ab> To perish. .²7 To fall out. --III. €1 <ab>P.</ab> (पदति) To stand fast or fixed.

पद् {%m.%} [पद्-क्विप्] (This word has no forms for the first five inflections; it is optionally substituted for पद after <ab>acc.</ab> dual) .²1 A foot. .²2 A quarter, a fourth part (as of a stanza).
